description: Compare cross-chain bridge routes, then build the signable transaction sequence for the winner. Returns a LIST of unsigned transactions -- some routes need an approval and a deposit signed in order, and signing only the first leaves funds approved but not bridged. Reports the destination chain and expected credit time. Bridging is not atomic. Never signs or broadcasts.

source.description: force a source instead of the winner

taker.description: the REAL wallet that will sign; placeholders rejected

name: prepare_best_bridge_route
